patterns.note: Sections frequently utilize full-bleed, high-resolution imagery or video as backgrounds, often with text and calls-to-action overlaid.
Content sections often employ an asymmetrical or split-screen layout, pairing a large image on one side with a concise text block and CTA on the other.
A clear typographic hierarchy is established using elegant serif fonts for prominent headings and clean sans-serif fonts for body text, navigation, and labels.
A sophisticated dark overlay, often with a subtle blue tint, is applied to most full-bleed background images and videos to enhance text contrast and maintain a luxurious mood.
The hero section features a full-bleed video that transitions to a static, darkened image on scroll, while its overlaid text content remains visible for a period before scrolling out of view.
The primary navigation bar is sticky and transforms its appearance, shrinking in height and gaining an opaque dark background, as the user scrolls past the initial hero.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video hero plays automatically, with text and a call-to-action positioned over it. On initial scroll, the video either pauses or transitions to a static, darkened image, creating a fixed background effect for the hero content before the entire section scrolls away. Concurrently, the sticky header shrinks in height and changes from transparent to an opaque dark background.
Sections are designed with large, high-quality images or videos that span the full width of the viewport, serving as immersive backdrops for textual content and interactive elements.
Content blocks often combine a dominant visual element (image or video) with a concise text description and a call-to-action button, arranged in a balanced yet dynamic composition.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a luxurious character, complemented by clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons and image cards, maintaining a refined but not overly soft aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and within content blocks, contributing to a premium and uncrowded feel.

standout: The site's standout feature is its seamless integration of high-quality, full-bleed automotive imagery and video with a sophisticated, transforming sticky navigation. This creates an immersive and luxurious brand experience that feels both modern and timeless, effectively conveying the prestige of Bentley.
